Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.
